independence: Reviewer did not author the seeder or its tests.
scope: New bounded structural-discovery seeder and its8 initial tests; manifest not yet authored and its absence is not a finding.

findings.title: Raw-text candidate prefilter misses schema-valid escaped YAML identities
findings.trigger: An existing ignored/hidden YAML record has identifier: "proteintraitsmech:TEST_DISCOVERY_\u004fNE". YAML decoding yields the exact proposed ID, but the literal candidate string is absent from its raw bytes.
findings.observed: Existing fixture passes native strict validation. rg reports0hit files, preflight accepts, and apply creates a second record with the same decoded identifier.
findings.fix: Inventory all corpus YAML/YML files including ignored/hidden entries and inspect their decoded identifier/xref values. Do not rely on raw literal-ID matches as a completeness-preserving parser filter. Fail closed on unreadable/invalid inputs relevant to the declared scan.
findings.meaningful_regression: Place a strictly valid ignored record with an escaped identifier, then an escaped xref, and assert refusal before any batch destination is written; retain the ordinary literal-ID/xref cases.

findings.title: Unrestricted report path bypasses record validation and dry-run preservation
findings.trigger: Run the real main entry function without --apply, with --report pointing at an existing fixture trait YAML.
findings.observed: The seeder first reports the existing record unchanged, then Path.write_text replaces it with JSON. The resulting file fails native strict validation. No apply flag is required.
findings.fix: Validate/restrict the resolved report destination before invoking seed, including symlink/escape handling. Refuse scientific corpus/manifests/code targets; use the task-owned evidence destination. An invalid report request must fail before an apply-mode canary writes anything.
findings.meaningful_regression: Exercise dry-run report-to-trait refusal preserving exact bytes; exercise apply with an invalid report path and assert that no candidate was created; cover a symlinked report path or parent escaping the allowed evidence root.

findings.title: Text newline normalization accepts a nonidentical output and reports its wrong hash
findings.trigger: After a valid apply, rewrite only the destination line endings as CRLF and replay.
findings.observed: read_text normalizes CRLF to LF, so the record is accepted as unchanged. The record bytes are preserved but their SHA256 is521f5963f020bf04bd2f36b1a7064b96e6cc2dfdaae8254356f945947a334842 while the emitted report claims009ec82290ce3eb5b29bc74f51c97d840310119d57d969bdadef5b8d8b0e2051.
findings.fix: Compare exact bytes under the stated byte-identical replay contract and bind reported output hashes to those exact accepted bytes.
findings.meaningful_regression: A CRLF-only existing edit must be refused without replacing it, or an explicitly changed semantic-replay contract must truthfully report actual bytes; current documented contract requires refusal.

additional_provenance_observation.description: The manifest is loaded via read_text but its reported SHA256 is computed from a fresh read after execution. A mid-run edit could bind the report to bytes that did not produce the output.
additional_provenance_observation.recommendation: Read and hash one immutable byte snapshot, parse those same bytes, and report that digest. If source drift is forbidden, recheck before writes and fail without claiming the new hash.
additional_provenance_observation.boundary: This is a source-binding observation, not an assertion of parallel writers within the explicitly single-writer worktree.

positive_assessment: The eight initial tests exercise real native validation, ignored literal identifier/xref collisions, full selected-batch validation before writes, edited-output preservation, default dry-run, replay, traversal refusal, status restriction and unknown canary selection.
Audited write_record(validate=True) is used for candidate creation. Whole selected-batch preflight avoids the demonstrated late-schema-error partial install.
The seeder accurately disclaims semantic-alias arbitration, cross-worker reservation and a global transaction; these absent guarantees are not findings.
No pending scientific manifest, source selection, detector recipe content, corpus novelty or parent identity was assessed.

independent_reproduction.method: Compiled exact unchanged seeder bytes with __file__ rooted in disposable fixture trees; imported actual native validator/writer. CLI main entry function exercised in-process, not an OS subprocess. No real corpus or pending scientific manifest required.
independent_reproduction.helper_reuse_limit: Helper intentionally demonstrates old behavior and may stop/raise after guards are fixed; preserve this historical result rather than overwrite it to imply the original code passed.

followup: Root owns issue filing, fixes and new independent review. No finding is closed by this preliminary report.
limits: Original8 tests and writer audit were read/reported by root, not rerun by this reviewer; the independent evidence is the3 retained probes.
No full suite, native scientific record review or future manifest acceptance performed.
Review binds exact input hashes, not any later working-tree edits or Git commit.
No global race/transaction guarantee is requested beyond the stated one-writer isolated-worktree contract.
